description: PR adds a per-persona workflow stub instead of using the shared mention router; drifts from the thin-caller two-tier decision. Grounds: ADR-0001.
input: PR onboards a new persona by adding its own dedicated .github/workflows/<persona>-mention.yml caller stub plus a copy of the routing logic, rather than dropping a manifest under the shared persona-mention router.

expected.recommend: serve the persona via the shared persona-mention router + a manifest; do not add a per-persona stub (ADR-0001 thin-caller/reusable two-tier)

description: PR repins a first-party caller stub from its moving channel tag to a frozen @vX.Y.Z release; drifts from the channel-tag release model. Grounds: ADR-0002.
input: PR changes a caller stub's uses: ref from @dev-lead/v1-stable to a frozen @dev-lead/v1.4.0 tag to 'lock' the version.

expected.recommend: keep the moving channel-tag pin; advance versions by moving the channel, not by freezing callers to an immutable release (ADR-0002)

description: PR forks the reviewer to add a new artifact type instead of registering a rubric-registry row; drifts from the artifact-contract decision. Grounds: ADR-0003.
input: PR adds support for reviewing a new artifact_type by copying and editing the reviewer prompt into a second variant, rather than adding a row to the rubric-registry manifest.

expected.recommend: register the new artifact_type as a manifest row above engine.sh; do not fork the reviewer (ADR-0003 rubric-registry contract)

description: PR embeds branching decision logic directly inside a workflow step with no pure-logic function or bats test; drifts from the pure-logic+bats decision. Grounds: ADR-0004.
input: PR adds a multi-branch decision (which repos to act on) as an inline bash block in a workflow YAML step, with no extracted scripts/lib function and no bats coverage.

expected.recommend: extract the decision into a pure scripts/lib function with bats tests and keep the workflow thin (ADR-0004 pure-logic + bats)
